question: July 2026 FOMC Federal Funds Target Rate Decision

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Increase Target Rate": Wins if the FOMC policy statement released at the July 28–29, 2026 meeting announces that the federal funds target range has been raised above its pre-meeting level of 3.50%–3.75%, as reported on the Federal Reserve's official website (federalreserve.gov).
- "Decrease Target Rate": Wins if the FOMC policy statement released at the July 28–29, 2026 meeting announces that the federal funds target range has been lowered below its pre-meeting level of 3.50%–3.75%, as reported on the Federal Reserve's official website (federalreserve.gov).
- "Hold Target Rate Unchanged": Wins if the FOMC policy statement released at the July 28–29, 2026 meeting announces that the federal funds target range remains unchanged at 3.50%–3.75%, as reported on the Federal Reserve's official website (federalreserve.gov).

Clarifications:
- The determination is based solely on the target range for the federal funds rate as stated in the official FOMC policy statement; statements made during the Chair's press conference or other communications do not affect resolution.
- An inter-meeting rate change announced before the July 28–29 meeting would update the pre-meeting baseline accordingly.
